writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the Inner Child lane writer

findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
findings.reason: The linter reads the heading alone as a paragraph. It is a heading over a paragraph of five sentences, so it lands nothing.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: A heading over its own paragraph follows that paragraph by design; nothing is reordered.
